title: Label: Meursault Premier Cru
scenario: **Domaine Morel** · **MEURSAULT** · **Premier Cru** · Appellation Meursault 1er Cru Contrôlée · **2020** · 13% vol · 750 ml

questions.stem: Which grape is this white wine made from?
questions.explanation: Chardonnay — Meursault is oaked Côte de Beaune Chardonnay.

questions.stem: Which level of the Bourgogne classification is this?
questions.explanation: Village name + Premier cru = Premier cru. A Grand cru would show the cru name with no village.

questions.stem: In which part of Bourgogne is Meursault?
questions.explanation: Côte de Beaune — famous for Chardonnay whites (Meursault, Puligny- and Chassagne-Montrachet). Côte de Nuits is Pinot Noir.

questions.stem: If this were a Grand cru, its label would carry the cru name without the village name.
questions.explanation: Grand cru labels name the cru alone (Corton, Montrachet); Premier cru labels are village + Premier cru.

questions.stem: **2020** on this label is the year of harvest. What is that called?
